text: Based on Earth-observation data, no deforestation (tree-cover loss of 0.5 ha or more) was detected on this 438.6-hectare rural property between 2021 and 2025. The asset had 34.5 ha of tree cover in 2000 but showed no forest cover in 2020 (per JRC data). While the analysis confirms no recent loss, it cannot rule out minor changes (under 0.5 ha) or edge effects, as the minimum detectable area is 0.5 ha with 30 m pixel resolution. The finding does not confirm regulatory compliance (e.g., EUDR) but supports a "deforestation-free" claim for the period evaluated.
